Abdul Ayub Nasir Sheikh vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr. Pso 
... on 20 August, 2024 
Author: Vinay Joshi
Bench: Vinay Joshi 
 
 1/2
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. 
 Criminal Application (Apl) No. 1123 
 Abdul Ayub Nasir Sheikh -Vs-State of Maharashtra 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Office notes, Office Memoranda of
 Coram, appearances, Court's orders 
 or directions and Registrar's orders. 
 ------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mr.S.A.Mohta, counsel for the applicant . 
 Ms.S.S.Jachak, A.P.P for non-applicant-State.
 Coram Vinay Joshi &
 Mrs. Vrushali V. Joshi, J
 Date : 20th August, 2024. 
 1. Heard.
2.  This is an application seeking to quash the charge-sheet bearing (SCC No.844 of 2023) pending on the file of Judicial Magistrate First Class, Nagbhid, district Chandrapur arising out of First Information Report No.99 of 2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 registered with Police Station Nagbhid District Chandrapur. 
3. The learned counsel appearing for the applicant has stated that the application of the other co- accused in the same FIR for quashing of the First Information Report in Criminal Application No.198 of 2024 is allowed by this Court on 26.07.2024. 
4. Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable on 02.09.2024.
